description: Forge step F5, first piece: a level that holds nothing of the original game loads and plays. The Blank Room (dev-mods/blank_room, built by its build_blank_room.py: one room 24 by 24 metres with four pillars, eight player starts on a ring, no objects) is staged as a mod and one ordinary client launch starts an offline Combat Simulator match on it with three simulants. Every level until now was cloned from a base arena and so embedded that arena's geometry; this one's floor, walls, texture, collision, pads and graph are all made by the builder. What this proves, by the game's own lines: the arena and its embedded scenario are registered on a private stage number; the collision is built from the level's own collision.obj with its flags file (96 triangles, none dropped); the scene is drawn from its scene.glb with its one texture decoded; the room domain is two rooms (room 0 and the room) and the tiles compile; the level graph is accepted with a trigger volume node for each of the eight bounds rows and the pickup and door rules wired (seven execution edges); the setup compiles with eight starts and no objects; the eight pads become eight waypoints and covers and every pad has a room; and the player spawns and stays live for three seconds. What it does not prove: how the room looks (one screenshot is taken for a person), whether simulants walk the ring of pads or stand, and whether a match with no weapon or ammo pickup is good to play. A level saved from this template holds only what is here, so it can be shared.

input_sequence.comment: Pause the script until the ordinary Combat Simulator player is continuously spawned, live, controllable and walking in the Blank Room.
Eight seconds in the room (the screenshot is taken at three), then a scripted exit.

required_lines: MODASSET\.COMPILER: built colmesh source=.*blank_room.* format=\S+ vertices=\d+ tris=96 skipped_degenerate=0 colflags=sidecar applied=\d+
SCENARIO\.RENDER: activated source scene 'mod_blank_room:scenario_blank_room' .*vertices=\d+ groups=\d+ materials=\d+ images=1
SCENARIO\.SOURCE: resolved room domain 'mod_blank_room:scenario_blank_room' rooms=2 declared=2 mesh_max=1
SCENARIO\.SOURCE: compiled scene tiles 'mod_blank_room:scenario_blank_room' for stage '[^']*' as 2 rooms, 96 tiles
SCENARIO\.GRAPH: trigger volume nodes '[^']*blank_room[^']*' nodes=8 rows=8
SCENARIO\.GRAPH: level program 'mod_blank_room:scenario_blank_room' nodes=\d+ exec_edges=7 modules=\d+ volumes=8
SCENARIO\.SOURCE: compiled setup\.fields\.json '[^']*blank_room[^']*'.* as 0 setup records, 8 spawns,
SCENARIO\.SOURCE: compiled pads\.json '[^']*blank_room[^']*' for stage '[^']*' as 8 pads, 8 waypoints, \d+ waygroups, 8 covers
